role: bounded sequential service simulation with delayed PN and public-data request marks; not historical BM counterfactual validation
registration_context: four received-BOA fixtures and 292 saved-state probes observed; all saved-state probes delivered the fixed 49 MW pulse; sequential pilot outcomes unobserved

roster.selection: same two explanatory V5 constants, first original April window; neither profile, reset stock nor window selected from new pilot outcomes

request_workload.input: cached April BOA receipt ledger only, including the existing one-day prefix
request_workload.marks: at each clock t, consider cached segments with t-60 < received_minute <= t and nonzero last_MW; select the maximum tuple (received_minute, unit_index, acceptance_number, stop_minute, start_minute); its sign(last_MW) defines a common site direction; if none, no new instruction
request_workload.mark_scope: publicly announced endpoint signs provide a lagged hourly simulation mark; original BOA magnitudes, durations and intervening receipts are not actual dispatch in this pilot
request_workload.proposal: if a mark exists, request both units at the relevant locked-PN anchor plus sign times 49 MW; request size never depends on declared availability
request_workload.pulse: one-minute ramp from current mandatory-reference power, 30-minute hold at absolute peak, one-minute return to reference power at minute 32; reference resumes afterwards
request_workload.no_instruction: retain the mandatory reference; fixed hourly service capacity is still assessed in both directions
request_workload.overlap: at most one common-direction site pulse per hour; no overlapping proposed pulses or independent mixed-direction site requests
request_workload.policy_independence: same request marks and fixed service obligation for all four runs; nomination and availability functions do not receive upcoming marks

information_and_control.reference: each simulated accepted pulse overrides locked PN only within its own interval; historical BOAs serve only as request marks and do not become prior accepted power in this new simulation
event_order: At a half-hour boundary shift previously nominated PN into the current and following locked slots
On an hourly request clock, compute export and import availability from current simulated SOC, locked PN and already accepted pulses, before revealing the mark to the dispatch rule

Reveal the fixed common-direction proposal; conservative_admission clips it to the corresponding declared range; full_request_reference executes the complete requested absolute peak; no instruction follows the reference
Record the admitted or reference pulse as an already received commitment

At the same half-hour decision, reuse nominate_units and unit_planning_terms with only own accepted pulses over the next 90 minutes and the unchanged per-unit target fractions; nominate the slot starting 60 minutes later
Execute the minute using exact gross import/export integrals and continuous stock extrema
information_and_control.order_scope: explicit discrete simulation order; the current two PN slots stay locked and the newly nominated third slot uses the now-received pulse, without any later receipt or future mark
information_and_control.tail: do not create nominations with delivery starting outside the 168-hour pilot; the final scheduled pulse and its full known 60-minute exposure finish within the pilot
information_and_control.known_unsafe_reference: record a commitment failure without allowing a new request to erase it
information_and_control.no_retuning: retain targets, equal 98 MWh inventory split, 98 MW gross site bound, 0.92 efficiencies, delayed control rule, hourly clock and fixed 49 MW obligation throughout all runs

outcomes.physical: continuous unit stock bounds and gross site power; stop the rollout at first physical violation and retain its minute and cause
outcomes.firm_availability: at every scheduled hourly clock assess both directional declarations against the fixed 49 MW per unit, even when there is no activation
outcomes.delivery: record upward and downward unmet energy per unit against the full requested absolute trajectory; no unit or direction netting
outcomes.service_failure: any known unsafe reference, directional availability shortfall, unmet requested trajectory or actual physical violation is a service failure; continue after service-only failures while physical execution remains safe
outcomes.window_success: all 168 hourly obligations satisfied and all 10080 minutes physically completed; a partial rollout cannot become a successful window
outcomes.report: retain all four run summaries and compact hourly declaration/nomination/event records, first physical failure and first service shortfall; no monetary outcome or full minute trace

decision: if accounting or causal ordering fails, repair implementation without interpreting outcomes; if a pilot has a physical or service failure, diagnose its first mechanism before any larger run; only after a complete service-successful pilot register the broader development population. These four windows cannot pass the original 95 percent development gate or establish source benefit
failure_probability_scope: unchanged original development criterion; not estimated from this four-run implementation pilot
limitations: The hourly sign mapping, fixed symmetric capacity and common-direction pulses define a new public-data-driven simulation task. Historical BOAs do not identify market dispatch after changed nominations or declarations. The pilot does not supersede V1-V5 fixed-request negatives or demonstrate OR submission readiness.
